title: Calculate the cost of one imported matching-factory recipe
statement: For Algorithm2 of Niazadeh-Paes Leme-Schneider2011.03865v2 at an unknown n-by-n matrix with all entries1/n, each attempted round tests n matching-edge and n-1 tree-edge independent coins. Conditional on proposed matching/tree success probability is n^(-(2n-1)), so mean rounds=n^(2n-1) and expected coin calls lie between n^(2n-1) and(2n-1)n^(2n-1), even with short circuiting. This is a cost calculation for THAT published recipe at THAT input, not an all-factory lower bound. Coordinate-coin access to an unknown optimal transport matrix is not supplied by P/Q sample access. Exact vertex marginals do not imply the required whole batch law, and its boundary exponential-tail exclusion is not a finite-mean no-go for this reuse model. The distinct held dice-enterprise body is not a premise.
